title: Muraja'ah: Al-Mulk with the half term's rules: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Haqqah; noon and meem recap and when letters meet
source: Written for quran/y8 lesson 21 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Muraja'ah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 21. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ (١) ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ (٢)

keywords.def: revision of what is already memorised

questions.q: Recite 67:1 to 4 and name every noon sakinah and tanween rule.
questions.a: شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ ikhfa; عَمَلًۭا ۚ وَهُوَ idgham with ghunnah if joined; طِبَاقًۭا ۖ مَّا idgham with ghunnah if joined; مِن تَفَٰوُتٍۢ ikhfa; مِن فُطُورٍۢ ikhfa; يَنقَلِبْ ikhfa; خَاسِئًۭا وَهُوَ idgham with ghunnah.

questions.q: Breakout pairs: recite Al-Mulk to a partner who marks the rubric (pupil PDF). Today's rota group recites 69:37 to 52 to the teacher.
questions.a: Partner rubric with scores and one target; the teacher records rota scores.

questions.q: Extend: find an iqlab in Al-Mulk.
Stretch: recite Al-Mulk and Al-Haqqah back to back.

questions.a: A) Ikhfa. Tanween before ق: ikhfa.

questions.q: Think again: Al-Mulk was memorised before this term. What is the risk of 'old' surahs, and what is your plan?
questions.a: They fade quietly. A fixed manzil day and a partner check keep them.
